Strengthen the call to action on the final slide by making the next step even more immediate and compelling.

alignment.summary: PitchCheck provides instant feedback on pitch decks and delivery before human review, primarily serving organizations like hackathon organizers and accelerators who prepare teams for pitch events. The product is offered via a license model for a set number of teams and preparation time.
recommendations: Explicitly mention the core functionality of Slide 3 (how Gemma analyzes the pitch/deck) in the speech to better connect the product to the problem.
Clarify the pricing discrepancy between the slide (€300) and the spoken pitch (€200) to ensure consistency.
Integrate the technical detail from Slide 6 (running on a laptop) more smoothly into the explanation of how the product works for the end-user (the team).
